mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT class) FROM ( SELECT fishClass AS class FROM fish_species UNION SELECT fishClass FROM whale_species UNION SELECT fishClass FROM invertebrate ) AS all_classes) AS classCount,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `order`) FROM ( SELECT `order` FROM fish_species UNION SELECT `order` FROM whale_species UNION SELECT `order` FROM invertebrate ) AS all_orders) AS orderCount,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family) FROM ( SELECT family FROM fish_species UNION SELECT family FROM whale_species UNION SELECT family FROM invertebrate ) AS all_families) AS familyCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fish_species) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whale_species) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invertebrate) AS speciesCount
